name: Cindy Lou Johnson
source:
Cindy is the younger sister of Susan, and has spent a lot of her adult years watching over Susan as she dealt with her PTSD caused by her previous relationships. She too had to deal with a partner that was manipulative through her daughter, but she has moved on and has become stronger than ever, including being one of the alpha females at work.
